status: pilot defaults of 2026-11-21, training options from the B0 runs of 2026-11-23 (docs/pinn/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md sections 7.1 to 7.3): log input map, smooth start profile with a zero last layer, the log residual scale for Adam and L-BFGS, then Levenberg-Marquardt on the balanced scale. Since 2026-11-24 every arm uses the same refine chain (B1 included, through the block Levenberg-Marquardt of pinn/lm.py), so all arms end on the same objective with the same optimizer. n_points, the budgets and the window edges are still pilot values until P2b and P3 freeze them.

Declared 2026-11-24, before the campaign; our choice. score_max: estimated relative wall error, between the converged runs of IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES 7.3 (4e-5, 3e-4) and the failed ones (0.04 and above). tail_share_max: reference A has 0.003, failed runs 0.6 and 1.8. boundary_max: exact mode meets B1 to B12 to rounding.
